description_html:
In a minimum vertex cover (MVC) problem, an undirected graph \(G=(V,E)\) is given, with a nonnegative weight on each node. The goal is to select a subset of nodes of minimum total weight such that at least one end point of every edge in the graph is selected.

All levels are generated on Barabási-Albert random graphs with the generator of [Huang23] (based on the generator of [Song20]; the easy, medium and hard levels are new and use the same code with different parameters). A graph with \(|V|\) nodes and affinity \(m_{BA}\) (each new node attaches to \(m_{BA}\) existing nodes) has exactly \(m_{BA}(|V|-m_{BA})\) edges. Node weights are drawn independently and uniformly from \([0,1]\), so the instances are weighted vertex cover problems.

Notation.

  • \(G=(V,E)\): undirected Barabási-Albert graph.
  • \(w_v\sim U[0,1]\): weight of node \(v\in V\).
  • \(x_v\in\{0,1\}\): 1 if node \(v\) is in the cover.

Formulation.

\begin{align} \min\ & \sum_{v\in V} w_v x_v \\ \textrm{s.t.}\ & x_u+x_v\geq 1, && \forall (u,v)\in E, \\ & x_v\in\{0,1\}, && \forall v\in V. \end{align}

There is one constraint per edge, so the number of constraints is \(|E|=m_{BA}(|V|-m_{BA})\).
changes: Objective corrected to weighted MVC: min sum w_v x_v with w_v ~ U[0,1] (all checked instances, all levels, have distinct real node weights in (0,1)); previously min sum x_v. The Huang23 paper appendix also states the unweighted form, but the instances and generator (createOptVC uses G.nodes[v]['weight']) are weighted.
'Node Degree' column replaced by 'Graph Parameter' (BA affinity m, which is what 5 and 70 were) and 'Avg. Degree' = 2m(n-m)/n.

Added generator description and edge count formula; fixed typos 'in given' and '::'. Removed the claim that the graph is 'typically Erdos-Renyi or Barabasi-Albert': all levels here are BA. Cite [Song20] for the original generator (if not already on the site: J. Song, R. Lanka, Y. Yue, B. Dilkina, A General Large Neighborhood Search Framework for Solving Integer Linear Programs, NeurIPS 2020).
verification: Generator: github amf272/Distributional-MIPLIB-Generators MVC/generator_MVC.py (identical gen_graph/createOptVC to local generator_MVC_MIS_CA_SC_MK.py): nx.barabasi_albert_graph(n, m=edge), node weight random.uniform(0,1), rows x_u + x_v >= 1, minimize sum weight*x.
MVC/easy test 0,1: 1200 binaries, 5975 rows = 5*(1200-5), all x_u+x_v>=1, min degree 5, objective weights in (0.0003, 0.9999).
MVC/medium test 0: 2000 binaries, 9975 rows = 5*(2000-5), min degree 5, weighted.
MVC/hard test 0,1: 500 binaries, 30,100 rows = 70*(500-70), min degree 70, weighted.
MVC/very-hard test 0,1 (MPS, present on HF though missing from hf_tree.txt): 1000 binaries, 65,100 rows = 70*(1000-70), min degree 70, weighted.
Very hard 2 not on HF: table 135,100 rows = 70*(2000-70); Huang23 Table 1 MVC-L 2,000 vars, 135,100 constraints.
